metadata.question: Does the chlorophyll concentration in the equatorial Pacific Ocean (around 140 degrees West) decrease in December 1999 compared to August 1998 ?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use NASA SeaWiFS Level-3 Standard Mapped Image (L3SMI) chlorophyll-a (chlor_a) ImageCollection. Query monthly periods: Aug 1–Sep 1, 1998 and Dec 1, 1999–Jan 1, 2000. AOI: small equatorial Pacific box around 140°W ([-145,-135] lon, [-2,2] lat).
2. Masking strategy: Rely on L3 compositing masks; compute valid pixel count vs total pixels to report data availability (acts like “cloud%”).
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: If collections empty -> C1. If valid pixel count == 0 -> C2. If mean is null/NaN or outside [0,100] mg m^-3 -> C3. Otherwise compare means; Dec 1999 < Aug 1998 => A, else B.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line

async function runAnalysis() {
  // Helpers
  const ev = (obj) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => obj.evaluate(resolve, reject));

  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const aoi = ee.Geometry.Rectangle({coords: [-145, -2, -135, 2], geodesic: false});
  const scale = 4000;
  const periods = [
    {label: '1998-08', start: ee.Date('1998-08-01'), end: ee.Date('1998-09-01')},
    {label: '1999-12', start: ee.Date('1999-12-01'), end: ee.Date('2000-01-01')}
  ];

  // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
  const datasetId = 'NASA/OCEANDATA/SeaWiFS/L3SMI';
  let collection;
  try {
    collection = ee.ImageCollection(datasetId).select('chlor_a');
    // Probe collection existence
    await ev(collection.limit(1).size());
  } catch (e) {
    console.log(`Dataset error: ${e && e.message ? e.message : e}`);
    console.log('D');
    return;
  }

  async function getPeriodComposite(period) {
    // Primary window
    let col = collection.filterDate(period.start, period.end).filterBounds(aoi);
    let size = await ev(col.size());
    let usedStart = period.start;
    let usedEnd = period.end;
    if (size === 0) {
      // Fallback: widen by ±15 days
      usedStart = period.start.advance(-15, 'day');
      usedEnd = period.end.advance(15, 'day');
      col = collection.filterDate(usedStart, usedEnd).filterBounds(aoi);
      size = await ev(col.size());
      if (size === 0) {
        return {status: 'C1', msg: `${period.label} Images: 0 (even after widening)`};
      }
    }
    // Composite
    const img = col.mean().rename('chlor_a');
    // Pixel counts
    const totalPix = await ev(ee.Image(1).rename('ones').reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: aoi,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('ones'));
    const statsDict = await ev(img.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.median(), sharedInputs: true})
                              .combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}),
      geometry: aoi,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }));
    const mean = statsDict ? statsDict['chlor_a_mean'] : null;
    const median = statsDict ? statsDict['chlor_a_median'] : null;
    const validCount = statsDict ? statsDict['chlor_a_count'] : 0;

    if (validCount === 0) {
      return {status: 'C2', msg: `${period.label} Images: ${size}, ValidPix: 0/${totalPix} (0.0%)`};
    }
    const validPct = totalPix && totalPix > 0 ? (100.0 * validCount / totalPix) : null;

    // Basic validation
    const invalid =
      mean === null || median === null ||
      !isFinite(mean) || !isFinite(median) ||
      mean < 0 || median < 0 || mean > 100 || median > 100 ||
      validPct === null;

    if (invalid) {
      return {status: 'C3', msg: `${period.label} invalid stats (mean=${mean}, median=${median})`};
    }

    return {
      status: 'OK',
      msg: `${period.label} Images: ${size}, ValidPix: ${validCount}/${totalPix} (${validPct.toFixed(1)}%), Mean: ${mean.toFixed(4)} mg m^-3, Median: ${median.toFixed(4)}`,
      mean: mean,
      median: median,
      usedStart: usedStart.format('YYYY-MM-dd'),
      usedEnd: usedEnd.format('YYYY-MM-dd')
    };
  }

  try {
    console.log(`Dataset: ${datasetId}, Band: chlor_a`);
    console.log(`AOI: lon[-145,-135], lat[-2,2], scale=${scale}m`);

    const res1 = await getPeriodComposite(periods[0]); // 1998-08
    if (res1.status !== 'OK') {
      console.log(res1.msg);
      console.log(res1.status);
      return;
    }
    console.log(`Window(1998-08): ${await ev(res1.usedStart)} to ${await ev(res1.usedEnd)}`);
    console.log(res1.msg);

    const res2 = await getPeriodComposite(periods[1]); // 1999-12
    if (res2.status !== 'OK') {
      console.log(res2.msg);
      console.log(res2.status);
      return;
    }
    console.log(`Window(1999-12): ${await ev(res2.usedStart)} to ${await ev(res2.usedEnd)}`);
    console.log(res2.msg);

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    const mean1 = res1.mean;
    const mean2 = res2.mean;

    if (mean1 === null || mean2 === null || !isFinite(mean1) || !isFinite(mean2) ||
        mean1 < 0 || mean2 < 0 || mean1 > 100 || mean2 > 100) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const decreased = mean2 < mean1;
    // Print a short comparison line
    console.log(`Comparison: Dec1999(${mean2.toFixed(4)}) vs Aug1998(${mean1.toFixed(4)}), Decrease=${decreased ? 'Yes' : 'No'}`);
    console.log(decreased ? 'A' : 'B');

  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
